title: Add docs/system-facts.md to planner and critic briefs, with drift test
summary: Create a short, sourced docs/system-facts.md of Athena run-time facts the code can't reveal, embed it in planner_brief and critic_brief, and add a test that fails when budget numbers recorded in the file differ from the budgets test's computed sizes. Audience: planner and critic agents, plus maintainers who edit the file.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for brief inclusion and budget drift; cargo test and clippy criterion.
Criteria run the tests and check the drift failing on a doctored value.
Each fact in the file cites its source; sizes are computed.
File written for an outside reader.
One focused change over the listed files.
Drift is enforced by a test, not prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The file is embedded with include_str! from docs/system-facts.md so the brief always carries the current text.
The banned words and fragments may be checked against boundary_words() by test as an extra guard, or cited by source.
The budget test compares numbers in a parseable form (e.g. a table) in the file to BudgetSet::budget() and computed estimated sizes for reader, producer, verifier, planner, critic and contract.
The BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-25 is not edited; it is owner context.
Facts are written from what the repository (BRIEF.md, docs, code) states; none are invented.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/system-facts.md exists, is short, and states each requested fact (host squash-merge with linear history and up-to-date branches; producer one-commit snapshot with no remote or other branches; reader/planner/critic plain copy without git or records/; prompt sets with budgets and current sizes; banned boundary words; plan request format; land lands only a job's pull request; records on athena/records after C0), each with a source.
planner_brief and critic_brief output includes the full text of docs/system-facts.md, and a briefs.rs unit test asserts it; run `cargo test -p athena-context`.

A new test in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs parses the budgets and current sizes recorded in docs/system-facts.md and fails when they differ from the budgets and computed sizes; run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`, and a negative test shows a doctored value is rejected.

The existing planner and critic budget checks in budgets.rs still pass, and the facts file is not counted against the always-loaded budget unless the budgets test deliberately includes it within limits; run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.
The banned boundary words listed in the file match boundary_words() output, or the file points to it as its source, so the list cannot silently go stale.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry and docs/decisions.md records the call (file choice, include in brief, drift test).
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check all pass at the repository root.

out_of_scope: Adding the file to reader, producer or verifier briefs
Changing budget numbers in athena-context lib.rs
Changing land, plan parsing or record-storage behavior
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass rate: the drift test must parse a doc and compute sizes, and snapshot-style tests of planner/critic briefs may need updating.
